topic: Measures to be observed while utilizing NAMS and performing the duties of Unit NAMS In-Charge/ assistance.
syllabus_extract: Measures to be observed while utilizing NAMS and performing the duties of Unit NAMS In-Charge/ assistance.
specific_objectives: 5.1.6.1 Trainee will be able to describe ILMS (Air), Modules of NAMS and Roles w.r.t Modules in NAMS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of NAMS Modules and Roles; Safety precautions regarding data integrity and access control; Instructor supervision during role-play scenarios.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of NAMS in Naval Aviation?
List three key modules within the NAMS framework.
Who is responsible for the daily maintenance of NAMS records?

development.content:
Introduction to ILMS (Air) System
Overview of NAMS Modules
Roles of Unit NAMS In-Charge
Assistance duties and responsibilities
Data entry and verification protocols

Measures for secure data utilization
Reporting procedures for anomalies
Maintenance schedules and logs
Interaction with higher authorities
Emergency protocols for system failure

Role-play: Handling system alerts
Review of standard operating procedures
Documentation best practices
Coordination with engineering teams
Final verification of duty logs

summary_questions: Explain the specific role of the Unit NAMS In-Charge in data security.
Describe the immediate actions required upon detecting a system anomaly.
How does the ILMS (Air) module integrate with other NAMS components?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the transition procedures for NAMS duties as detailed in LP 02.
